components.name: BloomMenu
components.doc: A floating button whose actions bloom outward along an arc, one after another, and fold back in reverse. It is a real menu: arrow keys move between actions, Escape or a click outside closes it and focus returns to the button.

components.name: BloomMenuPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: a capture board. Each action adds a card.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name of the action: the button's accessible name and the label shown on hover and focus.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: A disabled action stays in the arc but cannot be used.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Runs when the action is chosen.

members.name: actions
members.doc: The actions, placed along the arc in order. Three to six read best.

members.name: direction
members.doc: Where the arc opens, seen from the button. Use a diagonal for a button in a corner.

members.name: sweep
members.doc: Angle the actions spread over, in degrees. Defaults to 90 for diagonals and 150 for the four sides.

members.name: radius
members.doc: Distance from the button to the actions, in px. It grows by itself when the actions would overlap.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the menu opens or closes.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called with the action id when an action is chosen. The menu closes afterwards.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the floating button and of the menu.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Icon of the floating button. It turns 135 degrees while the menu is open, so a plus becomes a close mark.
